effectification.config.staticMappings.de: Applied when the game starts (a restart is needed after a change). For an id no installed mod registers (a removed mod, a command or data pack that uses it), the id is given to the target effect. A registered source effect is converted while playing, like a dynamic mapping.
effectification.config.dynamicMappings.d: Converted while playing: the target effect is applied wherever the source would be. Changes apply as soon as you save.
effectification.config.debug.desc: What the mod writes to the log.
effectification.config.debug.logLevel.de: NONE: nothing. ERRORS: errors only. WARNINGS: also mapping problems such as typos (recommended). ALL: also every conversion, for troubleshooting.
effectification.config.mapping.desc: Replaces one effect (or every effect matching a pattern) with another.
effectification.config.mapping.sourceEff: The effect to replace: an id (relics:stun), or a pattern with * (*:stun*). Exceptions follow after a space, each starting with ! (*:stun* !*:stun_immunity).
effectification.config.mapping.targetEff: The effect used instead. Several, separated by commas, are fallbacks: the first installed one is used.
effectification.config.mapping.amplifier: The level (amplifier, 0 = level I) is multiplied by this and rounded, within 0 - 255. 1 keeps it.
effectification.config.mapping.onlyVisua: Only the name and icon of the target are shown; the source effect keeps working as before.
effectification.config.mapping.unidirect: Checks for the source effect no longer find the converted effect, so the source mod's own handlers stop reacting to it.
effectification.config.mapping.extraAppl: Effects whose tick also runs while the converted effect is active, e.g. to keep the source's particles or sounds. Comma-separated ids; * allowed with a fixed part.
effectification.config.mapping.discardEf: Effects whose tick is blocked (they stay on the entity but do nothing each tick). Comma-separated ids or patterns.
